name: Focus mode
author: Daniel Killenberger
description: Plugin-owned distraction list with exclusive windows, always-on off-space site block, and a conscious-choice intercept banner. Focus mode start popup, session timer, and a closing window; mutes those apps while focused and shows one grouped count after you leave.
